question: What is the name of a kit developed by Tata Medical and Diagnostics in 2021 to detect the omicron virus?
solution:
The correct answer is __**OmiSure.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tata Medical and Diagnostics** is an** Indian healthcare company** that develops and manufactures** medical devices, diagnostics, and healthcare** solutions.
 
• The** omicron virus **is a new variant of the SARS-CoV-2 virus that causes COVID-19.
 
• It was first detected in** South Africa** in **November 2021 **and has since spread to other countries.
 
• The correct name of the kit developed by Tata Medical and Diagnostics in 2021 to detect the omicron virus is **OmiSure**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Omisure employs the approach of **S-Gene Target Failure** (SGTF).
 
• During the RT-PCR assays, the Omisure test kit finds the Omicron variant of SARS-CoV2 in the **nasopharyngeal and oropharyngeal tissues.**
 
• The Omicron version experienced many mutations in the S-gene; patients who test positive for Covid are identified via the** SGTF approach.**
 
• The viral genes that are targeted for Covid-19 virus detection are the **"S" gene, ORF, "N" gene, Rdrp, and "E" gene.**
